original_study_design: Cross-sectional case-control study nested in a population-based cohort of 70-year-old European women (145 women: 53 T2D, 49 IGT, 43 NGT). Only the T2D and NGT groups (n=96) enter the present analysis; the IGT group is not retained.
T2D_definition: WHO criteria based on oral glucose tolerance testing; participants with raised GAD antibodies were excluded to rule out autoimmune diabetes.
control_definition: Normal glucose tolerance (NGT) on OGTT; the pooled comparison does not include the source IGT group.
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Women followed from age 64 and re-examined at approximately age 70 in the Gothenburg area; source exclusions included chronic inflammatory disease and antibiotics in the preceding three months.
source_verification_note: T2D diagnosis is OGTT/WHO-based with autoimmune diabetes excluded, and treatment and HbA1c are documented per participant; sample-level re-derivation of case status from public summary tables was not independently repeated, hence A-. curatedMetagenomicData retains 96 of the 145 women (53 T2D, 43 NGT).

country: France and Germany (multi-centre; the Denmark site is not retained in the curated subset)
original_study_design: Prospective cross-sectional multi-centre study (MetaCardis, NCT02059538): 2,173 individuals recruited into eight cardiometabolic phenotype groups in Denmark, Germany and France. The curatedMetagenomicData subset used here comprises 655 samples (Paris n=358, Leipzig n=297).
control_definition: non-T2D controls; the control pool includes metabolically abnormal phenotypes (e.g., obesity and metabolic syndrome groups) and is therefore not metabolically healthy.
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Standardized criteria across sites; excluded: past abdominal malignancy, intestinal resection or radiation, chronic or acute inflammatory disease, autoimmune disease, organ transplantation with immunosuppressive drug intake, and severe kidney disease (eGFR <50 ml/min/1.73 m2); group-dependent criteria applied for phenotype acquisition.
source_verification_note: T2D classification follows ADA criteria and medication is captured as complete structured drug-class text (655/655), supporting grade A-; the retained limitation is that the non-T2D control pool includes metabolically abnormal individuals (obesity, metabolic syndrome), so controls are not uniformly healthy. Evidence grade A-.

original_study_design: Two-stage case-control metagenome-wide association study (MGWAS): 345 faecal samples in stage I/II plus 23 additional samples for T2D classification, recruited at the Medical Research Center of Guangdong General Hospital; curatedMetagenomicData retains 344 matched samples (344/344 metadata-sequencing match).
T2D_definition: T2D diagnosed according to the 1999 WHO criteria (Alberti & Zimmet 1999).
control_definition: Non-diabetic individuals (no T2D diagnosis under the 1999 WHO criteria).
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: T2D cases per the 1999 WHO criteria constituted the case group and the remaining non-diabetic individuals the control group; the source audit records no antibiotics in the preceding two months; detailed clinical information was collected per donor (Supplementary Table 1: FBG, FINS, FCP, HbA1c, lipids, blood pressure).
source_verification_note: Case definition is explicit (1999 WHO criteria) and a per-sample clinical table is published; 344/344 samples are matched between sequencing data and metadata in curatedMetagenomicData (345 MGWAS samples reported in the source; one sample not retained). Evidence grade A.

original_study_design: Cross-sectional community-based study of Cheyenne and Arapaho (C&A) adults with non-Native (NNI) comparison participants; 38 C&A individuals sampled for the faecal microbiome, of whom 37 are retained in the curated subset used here.
T2D_definition: Self-reported T2D status; no laboratory confirmation reported.
control_definition: Participants reporting no T2D; no uniform laboratory screening was applied.
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Adult C&A community members in Oklahoma (plus an NNI comparison group); phenotypic information (age, sex, height, weight, smoking patterns, self-reported T2D) was collected at the time of consent; no uniform clinical exclusion criteria were identified.
source_verification_note: T2D status is self-reported without uniform laboratory screening (approximately 50% of C&A participants self-reported T2D); smoking, antibiotic use and a 3-day food journal were collected, and town-level metadata exist; curated database retains 37 samples (Oklahoma). Evidence grade B because of the self-reported case definition.

original_study_design: Case-control study of colorectal cancer (CRC) with faecal metagenome sequencing of CRC cases and colonoscopy controls; T2D was recorded as a comorbidity. The present analysis uses 54 samples comprising 16 T2D and 38 non-T2D individuals.
T2D_definition: Type 2 diabetes recorded as a comorbidity (DM field in clinical records); diagnostic thresholds were not restated in the publication.
control_definition: Individuals without recorded diabetes (CRC cases and controls without a DM comorbidity record).
inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Participants undergoing colonoscopy were recruited; the source audit records exclusions for recent antibiotics, vegetarian diet, recent invasive procedures, prior cancer or intestinal inflammation; clinical parameters recorded included fasting blood glucose, lipids and liver enzymes (Supplementary Table S1).
source_verification_note: The aggregate of 16 T2D and 38 non-T2D samples in the analysis set is consistent with the database counts; however individual-level DM mapping cannot be independently rebuilt from the public summary tables, so evidence grade is B.
